# Vendored layout dependency

`elk.bundled.js` is ELK.js 0.7.1, sourced from the published `elkjs@0.7.1`
npm package. It is used locally by the optional schematic view for layered
placement, crossing minimization, fixed-port placement, and orthogonal edge
routing. ELK.js is distributed under the Eclipse Public License 1.0; the
complete license is included as `ELKJS-LICENSE.txt`.

The corresponding source is available from the upstream
[`0.7.1` tag](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/0.7.1).
